top_choice_rationale: Optical lattice clocks are a decisive, independently confirmed measurement advance: magic-wavelength trapping of many neutral atoms, reproduced at the 10^-18 level by several laboratories, opening a new regime for tests of gravity and fundamental constants. The Katori and Ye allocation is compact and the citation is scoped to the lattice clock, distinct from earlier comb and ion-clock prizes. The Higgs case I ranked first at opening is not on the slate, and a prize this mature is better than no award.
